what: Six-track groovebox firmware with 25 synthesis engines, 800+ presets and no samples. Chord layouts you play with one thumb, a 64-step sequencer, idea generators, songs with arrangement, SWARM, TRACE and XYZ sound-morphing pads, a browser editor and emulator.
author: Mello-D
sounds: licensed: the Juno-106 factory patch data (parameter settings, not recordings) as decoded by FM-106 (PatttF, GPL-3.0); everything else is made in code
